scripts.typecheck: effect-tsgo tsrs -p tsconfig.json && effect-tsgo tsrs -p src/solid/tsconfig.json && effect-tsgo tsrs -p src/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: effect-tsgo --tsrs-lint oxlint -c ../../packages/lint/oxlintrc.json src/spar src/spar-composed src/nav-spar src/foldkit src/nav-foldkit src/effect-ui src/shared scripts
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.spar.config.ts && vite build --config vite.spar-composed.config.ts && vite build --config vite.solid.config.ts && vite build --config vite.foldkit.config.ts && vite build --config vite.effect-ui.config.ts && vite build --config vite.react.config.ts && vite build --config vite.nav-spar.config.ts && vite build --config vite.nav-react.config.ts && vite build --config vite.nav-foldkit.config.ts && bun run --cwd ../bench-solid2 build

scripts.one-row: vite build --config vite.spar.config.ts --minify false --outDir ../../dist-readable/spar && bun scripts/one-row.ts

scripts.cpu: vite build --config vite.spar.config.ts --minify false --outDir ../../dist-readable/spar && bun scripts/cpu.ts
